hero.title: Advanced Car Plate Tracking System
hero.subtitle: Leveraging YOLO models for real-time vehicle and license plate detection and recognition.

about.title: About the Project
about.paragraph1: This project is a robust car plate tracking system designed to accurately detect vehicles and their license plates in various scenarios. It utilizes state-of-the-art YOLO (You Only Look Once) models for efficient object detection, followed by character recognition for the extracted license plates.
about.feature1: Vehicle Detection: Identifies cars, trucks, and other vehicles in video streams or images.
about.feature2: License Plate Detection: Precisely locates license plates on detected vehicles.
about.feature3: Character Recognition: Extracts and recognizes characters from the license plates using a custom-trained classifier.
about.feature4: Tracking: Implements object tracking to follow vehicles and their plates across multiple frames.
about.feature5: Database Integration: Stores detected plate information for further analysis.

tech.title: Technologies Used

tech.python: Python: Primary programming language for backend logic and model inference.
tech.opencv: OpenCV: For image and video processing tasks.
tech.pytorch_tf: PyTorch/TensorFlow: For training and deploying deep learning models.
